summary:
Welcome to RAMENCOIN

Back in March 2018 I put RAMENCOIN live on Ethereum. It was the first Proof of Ramen coin ever made, a mineable proof of work ERC20 token aimed at ramen fans and anime fans.

$RAMEN (BNB/BSC) CA: 0x0282c7fe8cc948655b1fb3628cdf466ced557777

You can still see my original BitcoinTalk post here:  

I also posted my original deployer wallet below so everyone can confirm I am the one who created it.

Here's the original Ramencoin on Ethereum 
And you can see it's verified.

The whole thing started while hanging out with friends, eating ramen and watching anime. Growing up as a Mixed Asian American (Chinese, Japanese, and Korean), ramen was always on the table at home. My parents cooked it so well. When I served in the military I got sent to Japan and tried a lot of the food there. It was really good, though my parents still made some of the best bowls I have ever had lol. 

I created Ramencoin because I did not want another random meme coin. I wanted something that could actually get used, like paying at ramen shops or covering anime subscriptions, and also help feed people who are hungry.

I handled everything on my own. Mining setup so people could mine from their computers, the site, the social pages, the whole community. 

Then I reenlisted back into the military. I had to leave the project for a few years because I could not run it properly while I was in.

I am home now and ready to start again. Crypto looks different in 2026 than it did in 2018. Binance Smart Chain feels like the right place for RAMENCOIN this time. It is quick, fees stay low, and it has solid security. It works well for community coins like this one.

The new launch on Binance Smart Chain will keep the same heart. Ramen and anime people coming together, having fun, and still aiming to help with hunger. The switch should go clean and give us room to add stronger features later.

Anyone who mined or held the first RAMENCOIN in 2018, good to see you again. Anyone new who likes ramen, anime, or projects with a real background, come on in. This one has actual history, not just a copy.

Drop a ramen bowl emoji if you want to stay in the loop. Keep following for the contract and the rest of the plan. Time to get the bowls filled once more.
